snippet.title: Cartoon Crime – Early Access Gameplay Trailer | Open-World Action Game
snippet.description:
Here’s an early look at Cartoon Crime, our open-world action game currently in Early Access.

We’re continuing to improve the animations, graphics, gameplay, and world as development moves forward. This trailer shows an early build, so some features and visuals may change along the way.

More gameplay, updates, and trailers are coming soon from Buba Games.
